summary: Otello Corporation ASA, through its subsidiary, Bemobi provides mobile solutions and platforms for digital payments, customer engagement, microfinance, and digital services in Norway. It provides Apps Club subscription service to mobile carriers and smartphone OEMs. The company was formerly known as Opera Software ASA and changed its name to Otello Corporation ASA in January 2018. Otello Corporation ASA was founded in 1995 and is based in Oslo, Norway.
